paras.urdu: ◆ ہائپر جیومیٹرک احتمالی تقسیم کا تغیر
ہائپر جیومیٹرک شناخت $\sum_{r=0}^{k}\binom{m}{r}\binom{n}{k-r}=\binom{m+n}{k}$ استعمال کرتے ہوئے

sections.content:
E(X)=\dfrac{k}{\binom{N}{n}}\binom{N-1}{n-1}

=\dfrac{K}{\dfrac{N!}{(N-n)!\,n!}}\;\frac{(N-1)!}{(N-n)!\,(n-1)!}=\frac{K\,n(n-1)!\,(N-1)!}{N(N-1)!\,(n-1)!}

=n\frac{K}{N}

◆ Variance of hypergeometric probability distribution

By definition

\text{Variance}=V(X)=E(X^2)-[E(X)]^2\qquad(A)

\text{As } E(X)=\frac{nK}{N}\ldots\ldots\ldots(1)

\text{Now } E(X^2)=\sum_x x^2\,p(x)

=\sum_{x=0}^{n}x^2\dfrac{\binom{k}{x}\binom{N-k}{n-x}}{\binom{N}{n}}=(0)^2\dfrac{\binom{k}{0}\binom{N-k}{n-0}}{\binom{N}{n}}+\sum_{x=1}^{n}x^2\dfrac{\binom{k}{x}\binom{N-k}{N-x}}{\binom{N}{n}}

=\sum_{x=1}^{n}[x(x-1)+x]\binom{k}{x}\binom{N-k}{n-x}\qquad\because x^2=x(x-1)+x

=\sum_{x=1}^{n}x(x-1)\dfrac{\binom{k}{x}\binom{N-k}{n-x}}{\binom{N}{n}}+\sum_{x=1}^{n}x\dfrac{\binom{k}{x}\binom{N-k}{n-x}}{\binom{N}{x}}=\left[1(1-1)\dfrac{\binom{k}{1}\binom{N-k}{n-0}}{\binom{N}{n}}\right]+\sum_{x=2}^{n}x(x-1)\dfrac{\binom{k}{x}\binom{N-k}{n-x}}{\binom{N}{n}}+\frac{nk}{N}

E(X^2)=\left[\dfrac{1}{\binom{N}{n}}\sum_{x=2}^{n}x(x-1)\frac{k!}{(k-x)!\,x!}\binom{N-k}{n-x}\right]+\left(\frac{nk}{N}\right)

=\dfrac{1}{\binom{N}{x}}\sum_{x=2}^{n}x(x-1)\frac{k(k-1)(k-2)!}{(k-x)!\,x(x-1)(x-2)!}\binom{N-k}{n-x}+\frac{nk}{N}

=\dfrac{k(k-1)}{\binom{N}{n}}\sum_{x=2}^{n}\frac{(k-2)!}{(k-x)!\,(x-2)!}\binom{N-k}{n-x}+\frac{nk}{N}

=\dfrac{k(k-1)}{\binom{N}{n}}\sum_{x=2}^{n}\binom{k-2}{x-2}\binom{N-k}{n-x}+\frac{nk}{N}

\text{Let}\quad y=x-2,\qquad x=y+2

\text{If}\quad x=2,\qquad y=0

If x=n, y=n-2, therefore,

$E(X^2)=\dfrac{k(k-1)}{\binom{N}{n}}\sum_{y=0}^{n-2}\binom{k-2}{y}\binom{N-k}{n-y-2}+\frac{nk}{N}$

Using the hypergeometric identity \sum_{r=0}^{k}\binom{m}{r}\binom{n}{k-r}=\binom{m+n}{k}

E(X^2)=\dfrac{k(k-1)}{\binom{N}{n}}\binom{N-2}{n-2}+\frac{nk}{N}

=\dfrac{k(k-1)}{\dfrac{N!}{(N-n)!\,n!}}\;\frac{(N-2)!}{(N-n)!\,(n-2)!}+\frac{nk}{N}
